extraction_notes: Family datasheet covering BZX584C2V4 through BZX584C43 (Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology Co., Ltd); the BZX584C3V3 row (marking code Z14) was used for all part-specific table values.
Zener impedance for variant-Z fitting (no dedicated schema field): ZZT = 95 ohm maximum at IZT = 0.005 A; ZZK = 600 ohm maximum at IZK = 0.001 A (p. 2 Electrical Characteristics, BZX584C3V3 row).
Temperature coefficient at IZTC: -3.5 to 0 mV/degC; admissible zener current IZM listed as 5 mA in the table (p. 2).
Maximum ratings (p. 1): PD = 150 mW, VF = 0.9 V max at IF = 10 mA, RthJA = 833 degC/W, Tj and Tstg -55 to +150 degC.

Fig.1 (p. 3, VZ up to 10 V) labels only the 2.4 and 4.7-10 V traces at the low end; the six traces between them (2.7, 3.0, 3.3, 3.6, 3.9, 4.3 V) are unlabeled and mutually crossing in the 2-4 V region, so the 3.3 V trace cannot be attributed with confidence and was not digitized.

Capacitance is a single digitized read of the 0 V bias family typical-capacitance curve at nominal VZ = 3.3 V (approximately 179 pF; the 1 V bias curve reads approximately 131 pF and the 50%-of-VZ bias curve approximately 118 pF); it is not a swept characteristic of this part. Curve ordering is physically consistent (50% of VZ = 1.65 V reverse bias sits below the 1 V bias curve).

Fig.5 axis calibration was verified programmatically against the log-decade gridlines (x decade width 261.5 px with log-spaced minor gridlines matching within 1 px; y decade width 154 px across three decades) in a 200 dpi render.
Forward voltage is a single maximum limit (0.9 V at 10 mA) from the ratings table; the datasheet provides no forward I-V curve, so only one VF point is available.
omission_reason: No part-specific curves were digitized. Fig.1 covers the 2.4-10 V family members but leaves the 2.7-4.3 V traces unlabeled and crossing each other in the 2-4 V region, making attribution of the 3.3 V trace unreliable; Fig.2 covers only the 11-43 V members. Fig.3 (temperature coefficient), Fig.4 (leakage), Fig.5 (capacitance) and Fig.6 (impedance) plot family-level quantities versus nominal zener voltage rather than operating characteristics of this part, so only a single-point capacitance read was taken from Fig.5.
